English සිංහල தமிழ் Fact Checked All Economy Society Environment Politics Health Methodology About Us Explore Fact-Checking Contact Us #false Did Modi say that Sajith’s victory will lead to good times for Sri Lankans? False An ‘X’ message allegedly issued by Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi is circulating on social media stating that if presidential candidate of Samagi Jana Balavega Sajith Premadasa wins the upcoming presidential election, Sri Lankans will live happily. by Anonymous | September 18, 2024 The message states that just as the victory of the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) brought good times to the people of India, the victory of Samagi Jana Balavega will also bring good times to the people of Sri Lanka. FactSeeker observed whether India’s PM Modi had posted such a message on his X account and it was confirmed that he had not posted such a message. Accordingly, FactSeeker confirms that the alleged ‘X’ message of Narendra Modi is false. Latest updates #misleading Did Sri Lankan MPs Receive a Rs. 60,000 Salary Increase? We are an independent fact-checking team affiliated with the Sri Lanka Press Institute(SLPI). The objective and long-term goal of the FactSeeker is to provide the public with reliable and verified content in the attempt of debunking mis/disinformation. The unit, with the SLPI, is committed to contributing to improved media literacy in Sri Lanka.
